goal: Every 3 hours the fable auditor looks over all of sw factory and tells the owner in its DM what is a problem, worth reporting, a suggestion or unusual, and says nothing when nothing stands out. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/fable-sweep.ts) reads :5184 across every agent that is not a test or archived: owner posts of the last 3 h that no agent answered after 10 min, owner posts whose delivery failed, stayed queued or reached no agent, jobs that read working with no new entry for 45 min (rule 6) and jobs that failed in the last 24 h, failed work and comm threads, duties whose last run missed or errored, and open board steps with no live job, running wait or open owner todo. Job entry times come from the pi-host thread files, read only. Each item carries its :5184 link and the context a reviewer needs to judge it (a duty's last three runs and fix step, a step's note, a stuck job's pi-host task state), so the Fable turn reads one file and posts and is raised once, then again a day later while it stays, so a quiet run starts no job and costs no Fable turn. A sweep that finds things is the duty working, so the headline counts findings not yet passed on: the run's fresh items until the DM holds the auditor's post from after the run, or its job answered "nothing to report" (c67). The after-job measure waits up to 10 min for that post, which is why the precheck's soft target is 11 min while a sweep itself takes under 1 s. Its first run on 11-22 took 0.4 s and found 10 items: 2 owner posts with no answer, 1 stuck job, 5 duties off target and 2 steps nobody moves.

metrics.label: Findings of the last sweep not yet posted to the owner's DM or judged nothing to report
Minutes since the last sweep ran, against the 180 min schedule plus 15 min

onMiss: This duty asks for a report, not fixes, so these lines replace the brief's lines on fix steps, subagents and the 3-line report. Judge from one file. The detail file the flagged lines name lists every item with its :5184 link and, under it, what you need to judge it: a duty's last three runs and its fix step, a step's note, a stuck job's pi-host task state. Read it once with one bash cat, then answer. Make no API call, read no thread file, board or skill, and start no job or subagent, since a sweep is one judgment of at most 3 tool calls and the first sweep cost $3.07 in 40 turns of that reading. Only when this brief's start time is more than 30 min before now (run `date` in the same cat call), read fresh data first: run `cd /home/sieun/.local/share/sieun-pi-apps-chat/current/apps/chat && PRECHECK_MODE=peek STATE_FILE=/home/sieun/.pi/agent/chat/agents/ag_fable-auditor/duties/d1.state.json OUTPUT_FILE=/tmp/fable-sweep-peek.json node --import tsx scripts/duties/fable-sweep.ts --agent ag_fable-auditor && cat /tmp/fable-sweep-peek.items.md` and judge that file instead. Add no fix step, change no board and edit no file. Pick what is a real problem, a thing to report, a suggestion or something unusual, and drop what is fine or marked "raised before". Your final answer is the text of the owner's DM post itself, with nothing before or after it, in Slack style: the answer first in one plain line, then one `- ` bullet per item with its link copied from the file and the agent that should take it, at most 120 words, with no headings, labels or tables. When nothing stands out, answer exactly "nothing to report".
